title: Fluxis
description: A Basic Economy Plugin for the Minecraft Servers!
body:
# FLUXIS ### *Modular Economy Ecosystem* > **Dynamic markets. Real supply & demand. Built for modern Minecraft servers.** ---
## 🛡️ What is Fluxis? Fluxis is a high-performance, modular economy plugin for Minecraft that brings **Dynamic Pricing**, **Stock-based Markets**, and **Advanced Trading** to your server. Unlike traditional economy plugins, Fluxis creates a *living economy* — player actions directly influence market value, prices shift with supply and demand, and the market breathes with your server's activity. Designed for the **SkyWind Alliance**. Built for everyone. --- ## ✨ Modules ### 🏦 Fluxis Core — The Heart The engine behind everything. No Core, no Fluxis. - **Dynamic Price Engine** — Prices rise when players buy, fall when they sell. Real economics. - **Fluxis Vault** — Items don't disappear on sale; they enter a shared vault, creating a genuine supply cycle. - **Economic Drift** — Prices slowly return to base value over time, ensuring long-term market stability. - **Activity Multiplier** — Market volatility scales with online player count, making the economy feel alive. --- ### 📊 Fluxis+ — Visuals See the market move in real time, without leaving your inventory. - **Live Sparklines** — ASCII price graphs in item lore showing the last 10 minutes of performance. - **Trend Indicators** — Visual arrows (↑ Rising, ↓ Falling, → Stable) on every tracked item. --- ### 🏛️ Fluxis Action — Auction House A full-featured, persistent auction system. - **Global Bidding** — List any item for auction; the highest bidder wins. - **Paginated GUI** — High-performance interface supporting thousands of active listings. - **Persistence** — All auctions survive server restarts. Nothing is lost. --- ### 🤝 Fluxis TradeGUI — Safe Trading Peer-to-peer trading without the risk of scams. - **Split-screen GUI** — Both players see exactly what they're giving and receiving. - **Ready-Check System** — Both sides must confirm before any items change hands. - **Anti-Scam Protection** — Any inventory close cancels the trade and returns everything to its owner. --- ## 🛠️ Commands | Command | Description | |:---|:---| | `/shop` | Open the Dynamic Market GUI | | `/sell` | Open the Bulk Sell Vault | | `/auction` | Open the Auction House | | `/auction sell ` | List held item for auction | | `/trade ` | Request a safe trade | | `/fluxis balance` | Check your current balance | | `/fluxis reload` | Reload all config files (admin) | | `/fluxis event` | Open event control panel (admin) | --- ## 🔐 Permissions | Permission | Description | Default | |:---|:---|:---| | `fluxis.use` | Base access | `true` | | `fluxis.command.market` | Use `/shop` | `true` | | `fluxis.command.sell` | Use `/sell` | `true` | | `fluxis.command.auction` | Use `/auction` | `true` | | `fluxis.command.trade` | Use `/trade` | `true` | | `fluxis.market.buy` | Buy from market | `true` | | `fluxis.market.sell` | Sell to market | `true` | | `fluxis.auction.buy` | Buy from auction | `true` | | `fluxis.auction.sell` | List auction items | `true` | | `fluxis.admin` | Admin panel & reload | `op` | --- ## 🔗 PlaceholderAPI Support > Requires PlaceholderAPI. Run `/papi ecloud download Fluxis` after installation. ### 👤 Player | Placeholder | Description | |---|---| | `%fluxis_balance%` | Current balance | | `%fluxis_balance_formatted%` | Balance with separator (1,250.00) | | `%fluxis_balance_fixed%` | Shortened (1.2K, 3.5M, 2.1B) | | `%fluxis_total_earnings%` | Total earnings | | `%fluxis_total_transactions%` | Total transaction count | | `%fluxis_top_sold_item%` | Most sold item | ### 📈 Market (Per Item) | Placeholder | Description | |---|---| | `%fluxis_market_price_%` | Current price | | `%fluxis_market_trend_%` | Visual trend | | `%fluxis_market_stock_%` | Stock level | | `%fluxis_market_base_price_%` | Base price | | `%fluxis_market_min_price_%` | Minimum price | | `%fluxis_market_max_price_%` | Maximum price | ### 🌍 Global | Placeholder | Description | |---|---| | `%fluxis_multiplier%` | Activity multiplier | | `%fluxis_market_item_count%` | Total market items | | `%fluxis_most_traded_item%` | Most traded item | | `%fluxis_server_total_transactions%` | Server-wide transactions | | `%fluxis_server_total_volume%` | Total trade volume | | `%fluxis_online_traders%` | Online player count | | `%fluxis_last_transaction_time%` | Last transaction time | | `%fluxis_next_market_update%` | Next market update | --- ## 🚀 Installation 1. Download the latest `.jar` from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fluxis) or [GitHub Releases](../../releases) 2. Drop it into your `plugins/` folder 3. Install **Vault** + a compatible economy plugin 4. (Optional) Install **PlaceholderAPI** for scoreboard support 5. Restart your server 6. Configure `database.yml` with your MySQL credentials before going live --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Files | File | Purpose | |---|---| | `config.yml` | Core settings and module toggles | | `messages.yml` | All chat and admin messages | | `economy.yml` | Currency display and Vault behavior | | `shop.yml` | Market, trade, and auction tuning | | `shopmenu.yml` | Grouped shop layout (Foods, Mines, etc.) | | `database.yml` | Storage mode and DB credentials (default: MySQL) | | `integration.yml` | Platform and hook metadata | | `events/*.yml` | Event definitions for the Event Panel | --- ## 🧩 Compatibility Fluxis runs on any **Bukkit API compatible** server — Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and Folia. Vault is required for all economy operations. --- ## 👨‍💻 Credits Developed by **Levxys** — SkyWind Alliance *Justice. Equality. Integrity. Transparency.*
